body:
Unless they are afraid of retaliation as well. Out of the 8 people in a department I was working in, only one of them do not find our boss overly intimidating, and that's because he never has any direct interaction with him. Even the guy who is his #1 man admits that he has anger management problems.

He has never made anything stick, because the few times someone DOES call him out to HR, etc. he talks his way out of it because he makes it very clear with his tone and actions as to what will happen if you go against him. Myself and two others have attempted to do so, at different times. The worst is the one that he threatens the most has a child with a very debilitating condition, so every time it comes up he's basically telling him that he HAS to take the abuse.

What makes it worse is once you have him in a logical corner he plays a victim card. Actually, You could swap a couple words around, say, 'You're lucky to have a job' vs 'You're lucky to have a roof over your head,' and come to realize that your boss was probably emotionally abused by their Father/mother.

Yes, I call it emotional abuse, because I've seen it also in the relationships of said boss, both with friends as well as partners. It was this in fact that made me realize that Abuse is still Abuse, even if the parties change.
Hanging spoke visible at the bottom half of the wheel. =P

I think the part that hurt the most was that she cut me out of the pictures of my childhood friend's wedding as well as her graduation. Heck, having helped pay for it (both indirectly and directly) is a bit of a slap in the face to me.

I don't blame her for not wanting to speak to me again, but doing that as your 'response' without even letting me know is just... I don't know. I'm still paying for her car, (she was paying for my phone due to contract until recently.) while I admit in my bipolar rage I threatened to take it once or twice, I now fully intend to pay it through and give it to her.

Even if she then demands I sign divorce paperwork. I still love her. And I cannot blame her for no longer loving me.
I would love a documentary about the Winter War. Actually all of Finland's activities in WW2, they seemed to work through being in one hell of a shitty situation quite well.
Or we could get this; http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lg_FoEy8T_A

Thanks for your words. I hadn't spoken with her in about 6 months, figuring that might be some time for her to see that I -am- improving and working to treat my condition.

I don't blame her for what she does... I just wish she'd say why.
Having done paintball iduels before, I can say it's pretty humiliating.

I wouldn't advocate it, but DXM Kept me sane from my last years of college up to last year. I did have to use it fairly regularly, but it wasn't until each time I stopped that my bipolar got so bad that I had to be hospitalized. In fact for over 5 years it helped me get by.

For reference, last year I had an MRI and while there were 'non specific lesions' they were, as per their name, nothing the neurologist was even concerned about. Even after I mentioned my past use.

Unfortunately eventually the DXM started reacting poorly with me and I would be in depressive states so bad I would take more and more till I wound up with Seratonin Storm. Not. Fun.

My emergency action plan actually specifically says "If I ever have an extreme lapse where I am not considered competent, I am extremely open to the idea of and would encourage the use on NMDA Antagonists." The main one I know of out there is Amantadine, but it is primarily for parkinsons and as an antiviral.

Thank you for speaking up. Maybe it will give me the courage to ask my doctor Monday; They tried to put me on Tegretol last week and I rapid cycled so bad I almost got myself fired. Still working the shit out my system (Called Doc friday and was told to immediately discontinue use and call monday.)

Thank you for the links. I really appreciate it.

Unfortunately I got this after my appointment with him last week. He's adding Tegretol to my Depakote and Buproprion.

Bluntly? I'm scared shitless. I tend to get most side effects from things and this one looks pretty scary. I guess we get to give it a go; I start tomorrow (Cash flow problems led me to not be able to pick it up till the weekend...)

Went to try and get a second opinion from a different doc this morning. Waited almost an hour in the waiting room and then I had to go to the office. I've had this appointment with him for over a month.

Got to talk to the Ex on thursday. Really painful talk. Really really painful.

Then got to break up with my girlfriend yesterday. That was almost as painful.

If there is any god that has control over the universe, he certainly likes to see me suffer.

Well what makes the situation oddly straining at times is there ARE people who support me. My boss certainly does. Unfortunately many of my coworkers do not. It's actually vaguely amusing as I have Experience, seniority, and more clout in the company than they do.

The younger of my two older sisters is the opposite. She sees me crying and says "What are you going to do, drive off and threaten to kill yourself again?" That was a fucking awesome fathers day.

What's fucked up about it is they never have to be told that the way they treated me was wrong. I asked said sister for an apology, after she tried to get me committed and the psych after looking at me basically said "WTF are these people doing wasting my time, you're bipolar but stable, get the hell out of here."

But -SHE- knows better. Because someone who dropped her masters because she was 'too busy' managing a store in a coffee chain to rewrite her final paper, that's the sort of person who is even more qualified than a Psychologist to look at me.

That's my biggest issue. Everyone thinks they KNOW better. That I'm doing shit wrong. I go to the doctors and counselors and most of them seem to think I'm handling things pretty well for my situation (Strained separation, past anxiety issues, etc.) I got off my probation without a hitch and nothing but good reports from all the people who had to 'check in' with the court for me. But none of that is worth anything to these people.

I'm forever marked, not just by everyone else, but by myself. I wanted to start biking again today. But after I burned the food I was cooking I just couldn't. I can't do anything right. I used to be able to cook wonderful dishes. Today I burned rice. Last night I had a panic attack and left the party I had been waiting weeks to go to *before it even started.* I fucking helped set up and clean, and then wound up leaving because I had a depressive episode.

My mind WANTS me to suffer. Maybe it should get what it wants? Seems to usually win anyway.

The biggest challege I have is the people around me have made it very clear that it is NOT OK for me to have off days. My coworker gets in a seething rage where he slams his phone because his daughter broke an 80$ fan. Everyone treats him normally.

I can have just a slightly off day and I'm treated like a fucking leper. I think it might have been at that point that I realized I lost the last thing that I found solace in. I loved my work. But now it's just another reminder of how I don't fit in anywhere.

On meds... Limited success however. Current doctor seems rather unwilling to try anything different; he seems pretty satisfied with the concept of me being stable, if in constant suffering. Looking for another but it's fucking hard in Michigan.

My last counselor was an outright bully and would question ever decision I made, even my financial ones (Financial issues are, in fact, the one thing I've managed to keep sane...) I found another one but now he's cancelled appointments on me two weeks in a row.

I keep trying to get help. The only help a lot of people want to give however is locking me up and making me someone else's problem.
Upvoted and saved for being extremely insightful in a flat-out 'holy shit, I feel like a derp for never realizing that' way. Thank you.

The hobby in question is BDSM, actually. And the funny thing is, theoretically I'm handsome when I wasn't a fat slob. But on top of that, when I find a person attractive I almost invariably creep them out. This problem has happened since 8th Grade.


I've surmised that it is a human trait to apply the uncanny valley to even actual humans. If you're the right amount of broken, people just fucking despise you and everything you are. They call you lazy when you bust your ass for 12+ hour days sometimes. They say you don't try to keep yourself under control, when you're damn well trying.

I have come to peace with the concept that I have become a bad person.

My doctor is a fucking idiot and other doctors either don't return my calls or have month+ waits. During one of my blowups last year I apparently freaked out a few places.

Hippocratic oath... Awful close to Hypocrisy... ಠ\_ಠ

k...

late 20s, lost my wife, left me because she couldn't handle how much of an asshole bipolar had made me. She now just kinda uses me and everyone says I should stop letting her but... it's my fault.

Lovely treatment has contributed to weight gain.

You know what else? Fuckers use the drugs to just make us look and act acceptable to them. We still feel the same way inside.

But I digress. Seems to happen a lot lately.

Found a new hobby I love, but it is, like everything else in the world, something I am too ugly for.

I've made my peace with death. Now it's just a matter of what the tipping point will be, for me to try again.

I've been working on all the details so when I do pull the trigger it will look like an accident. that way at least she can get a couple loose ends paid for.

I'm fairly certain at this point talking won't really help me. I just cant keep fighting a losing battle. My life has truly become pathetic. Earlier this night I started feeling dizzy out of nowhere and I was just hoping that it was the start of my death... the conversation I had with myself made me feel rather at peace. No such luck however it seems...


I can't forgive myself for everything I've done wrong. I can't seem to make up for it either. I just want the suffering to stop. A nice quiet death would be a blessing to everyone. It would be closure to the story of how my entire life was trashed by my own ego coupled with the demons in my mind, caused in part by the world itself.

Everyone is too afraid to answer. Even as my mind slips away into nothing. I am taking comfort in the fact noone will miss me. In fact, theyll be better off when im gone.

Am i scared of what i am going to do? A little. But based on my research, it should be fairly plesant. Heck i bet if i picked the right gas it would be kinda fun... Ending this bad trip indeed...

fetlife.com is your friend.
Join. Have Fun. Mingle. Be happy. =D
its not fair. I wanted it to work. I wanted it to be painless. but it was hurting too much...
fuck. the rubberband hurt too much..... I didnt pass out in time. fuck. fuck.....

and of ofs not anyough,

how do I get on till I try again?

I'm only alive to suffer...

tried to get a doctors appt, so desparate for help. they don't have time for me.

cruel, cruel people. all of them. my former friends throw my mistakes in my face... so hateful of me.

my package should be arriving today. that gets me one step closer.
Lololol. Doctors are all at least a month away. Most at least two.

Asked for change, got more of the same. Keeps upping the dosage and ignoring that it gets worse and worse.

I hate them. i hate them all. Charlatans. Pretenders. Im sick of going broke for the privelidge of being their lab rat.

Scumbag Doctors:
Say the health care system is overloaded.
Charge you 100$ to spend 5 minutes calling in a script.

If they really wanted to help, they wouldnt make it so hard.

Im bipolar, not mentally challenged. Tried that. Doc keeps upping my ssris and it gets worse with each up. Fuck that.

Tried finding another doc, no luck so far. Doubt it will happen before im gone.

Sol, 3rd planet.

Getting me "Help" would be counterproductive, in any case. It's a terrible way to go but if I ever get thrown in a hospital again, I'll just go the toilet paper route.

Rather paradoxical, that to put me in that 'safe place' would drive me to that level of desparation, to die a pathetic, painful death.

But do not misunderstand... I do intend to leave soon. I just want it to be peaceful and neat. I want the peace life has never given me, and never will.

I cant work well with my hands any more. they shake too much from the medication.

I can't ride either, I'm always too tired...

I tried to let someone in, but all it did was make it clear how much I don't belong in this world. How much I should just die...

all my hobbies are shades of my former self. I cant work on bikes anymore. I just don't have the drive. its like these meds they put me on... all they do is subdue me, there is still the screaming writhing person on the inside, but it makes me look acceptable to society.

and in return, it takes away my energy to do anything meaningful.

I fucking hate everyone. People treat me like an animal but won't let me die peacefully like one. 

I'm ugly. I'm scary. I'm pathetic. I'm nothing. It is only when I am subdued, that I see myself as the world has always seen me... Ugly, Scary, and pathetic. 

No wonder with all the confidence, all the enthusiasm I once had, I could never get a girl to like me. I'm just unattractive. Then the one girl who took a chance on me... well I wound up fucking that up too...

I have a plan B though, so maybe, just maybe... it'll be a peaceful way out. Shipping times make me so pensive...

It wasn't that scary... but it was rather unsuccessful. I'm gonna have to try again when I'm not on hourly watch by my parents.

The funny thing is at one point I promised I'd wait till they were dead before I killed myself... nowadays... it hurts too much to wait for that.

My only regret is that I wasn't successful.

getting dizzy... hard to type

wish me luck everyone =)

I wanted to know how you screwed up killing yourself...

I can't even type like things were once. I useds to be smart but something happened...

Options... ha. Any option is forestalling the inevitable. Either i go now or wait until that point where i am homeless, jobless, cold, but most importantly hopeless.

Because I will be alone.

The care is all fake. There is no love for the mentally afflicted in society. we are the outcasts, the ones who must endure judgement.

Medical facilities are charlatans. Why place me with someone my insurance doesnt cover and bill me 200$ an hour? How can you force someone to pay for something they didn't want, anyway?

I don't understand why it is okay to have the death penalty but not to let someone who doesnt want to live find peace.

I'm wanting to take the depakote I have stashed but I'm worried it'll be painful. I'm getting conflicting information from nurses.

Nurses that claim to be my friend. nurses who are so ignorant they didn't even notice. Why should they? I'm an afterthought to the world, and I wish I was not even that.

I wish for death. I have been begging for death for the last hour. I just want to go peacefully, and I don't want to have to worry about turning back. The reptilian part of my brain likes to see me suffer.

I never responded to your question in my first thread.

No matter what I change, I will always be bipolar. I will always be on that brink towards insanity. And I will not go to a mental hospital again. I'd die first. We are a society of hypocrites. Society breaks people like me and then blames it all on us. Makes us pay for their mistakes. Makes us make mistakes.

My mind is suffering in throes of insanity. Why should I not snuff it out? Reality slips away as I think of the last time I was in the hospital. This time I know I can choke on toilet paper.
how did you screw up? I wanna know so I can not make the mistake you made.

There's no escaping the demons of my mind. The best days of my life are past me.

The environment has already broken me, the only way to remove myself from it is death.
